facts.fact: TXD requests host TxS and supplies pid.
Missing WCID or NO_ACK flag returns MT_PACKET_ID_NO_ACK without software status allocation.
Reserved NO_ACK PID is discarded before WCID lookup.
SN_VALID is cleared for frames other than QoS data or BAR; upstream is not evidence of unique beacon SN.
Per-BSS BCN/BMC flush polls busy and returns on timeout. This is register/queue behavior, not a no-future-vendor-TxS protocol specification.

conditional_host_invariant: One permanent P is excluded from every software reservation/allocation/init/reset path.
Only intended ra2 beacon submissions use P; no software status metadata is created for P.
All P reports exit before lookup, slot removal, callback or ownership accounting.
No previously status-tracked ra2 non-P report may be treated as covered by the P invariant.
proven_if_invariant_holds: Arbitrarily late or duplicate P reports cannot consume a current software reservation, independent of reply latency or PID wrap.
remaining: Implement and verify invariant in actual generated source before claiming host fix.
Replace TxS-IDLE beacon pacing with a separately justified DMA/queue lifecycle.
Establish per-ra2 RF/BCN/BMC/AC stop boundary and old non-P report transition.
Preserve Main/Guest and MCU ACK stale protection.
cleanup: Upstream source read in memory; only source hashes/facts retained.
